facts.text: Hotel Arts Barcelona is described as an artistic urban resort where the energy of the city meets the tranquility of the coast.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Arts Barcelona offers a distinctive artistic urban resort experience where the energy of the city meets the tranquility of the coast.

facts.text: The Family Pool is a space for guests of all ages, surrounded by landscaped gardens and overlooking the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: The Family Pool provides a welcoming space where guests of all ages can relax together, surrounded by landscaped gardens and overlooking the Mediterranean.

facts.text: The Gehry Pool is an adults-only infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: the Gehry Pool is an adults-only infinity pool

facts.text: Enoteca Paco Pérez is the hotel's Michelin two-star restaurant, where chef Paco Pérez presents Mediterranean cuisine.
facts.excerpt: At our Michelin two-star restaurant, he presents imaginative Mediterranean cuisine celebrating the freshness of the sea and the rich flavors of farm and mountain produce.

facts.text: The hotel's reimagination project is in its final phase, continuing through June 2027.
facts.excerpt: the final stage of this project will continue from now through June 2027.

facts.text: Selected indoor and outdoor spaces have temporary and partial closures during the final phase of the renovation.
facts.excerpt: selected indoor and outdoor spaces will experience temporary and partial closures as we complete this next chapter

facts.text: The Arts Wellness spa is located on the 4th floor.
facts.excerpt: Discover a world of tranquility at our luxury wellness facilities, now located on the 4th floor.

facts.text: An appointment is required at the Arts Wellness spa.
facts.excerpt: An appointment is required at Arts Wellness.

facts.text: The hotel runs Arts Kids, a curated programme for younger guests.
facts.excerpt: younger guests are welcomed into a world of discovery through Arts Kids, a thoughtfully curated programme

facts.text: Arts Kids is led by Frankie the Whale, a character inspired by the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: Led by Frankie the Whale, the friendly character inspired by the Mediterranean

facts.text: The Arts Suite has a bathroom with a private sauna and a walk-in dressing room.
facts.excerpt: a bathroom with a private sauna, alongside a walk-in dressing room.

facts.text: The Skyline Suites feature views of the Sagrada Família.
facts.excerpt: Sagrada Família views take centre stage in the Skyline Suites

facts.text: Guest rooms have exclusive headboards by Lorena Canals.
facts.excerpt: exclusive headboards by Lorena Canals

facts.text: Marina Coastal Food serves Mediterranean coastal cuisine with sea views.
facts.excerpt: A celebration of Mediterranean coastal cuisine with sea views.

facts.text: Barcelona-El Prat Airport is 20 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Distance from Property: 20.0 KM

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded Club booking.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club.

facts.text: The property was built for the 1992 Summer Olympics.
facts.excerpt: Built for the 1992 Summer Olympics

facts.text: The Marina Family Pool is open every day during summer season and is exclusive to hotel guests.
